title: tragacantha poliotes
intro: Tragacantha poliotes, commonly known as the Tragacanth, is a type of plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of gastrointestinal issues and as a demulcent to soothe irritated mucous membranes. The health benefits of Tragacantha poliotes include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve constipation, and reduce inflammation in the digestive tract. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its emollient and protective properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as tragacanth, a complex mixture of polysaccharides, and other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids.
